description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data entries in the 1.4 million open-source distilled reasoning dataset based on the presence or absence of reference answers and test cases. It is divided into three categories: “Null” (39.2%, 549,238 entries), represented in pink; “Have reference answer” (38.9%, 543,935 entries), shown in blue; and “Have test case” (21.9%, 306,818 entries), depicted in light green. The chart visually emphasizes that nearly equal proportions of the dataset lack any reference material (“Null”) and contain reference answers, while a smaller but significant portion includes test cases. A legend in the upper left corner clarifies the color coding and exact counts for each category, and percentage labels are placed directly on or near each slice for clarity. The data suggests that while reference answers are nearly as prevalent as missing ones, test cases are less commonly available across the dataset.
